tom: I can draft SKU copy. Marketing wants T+1h embargo. Legal needs 48h review tho.

raj: yep legal needs until May 30 EOD if marketing insists T+1. I'll review the copy once Tom posts.

matt (NimbusGrid): we will provide a cloud image + template and a short token for the demo. We'll also record a 90s clip as backup.

lina: great. Tom, put SKU 1-line + 2 bullets in the shared doc. Add IP/NDAs per Raj's comments.

tom: done: https://docs.google.com/d/1MarketDraft - added bullets + CTA.

raj: added legal clause: "No confidential customer data disclosed." Also request fictional customer names in slides.

publish-bot: ops request created: reserve-capacity --region us-west-2 --units 2 --when 2026-06-02T09:00:00Z

lina: logistics: 45m slot. Proposed flow: intros 8m, live deploy 15m, architecture 12m, Qs 10m. Tech rehearsal Jun 1 10:00am PT.

matt (NimbusGrid): bio + headshot uploaded. We'll deliver 90s MP4 by May 29.

tom: events ask: 150 tees, 300 stickers. Sylvia/ops to ship to Redwood Events, 1200 Mission St. Size breakdown: 40 L, 50 M, 40 S, 20 XL.

raj: legal approves announcement copy pending final SKU line.

lina: final actions: Tom - SKU copy (by May 28). Matt - bio + 90s clip (by May 29). Raj - legal sign-off (by May 30). Sylvia/ops - reserve capacity + ship tees (by Jun 1). Any blockers?

matt (NimbusGrid): none. Looking forward to rehearsal. :rocket:
